text:
Sam: Heads-up  Velaris (ACCT-VL-22) asking for a special introductory rate for first 6 months. Sales submitted a signed LOI with a 35% off list for months 1-6 to secure a multi-year commitment. Invoice VEL-2026-07-01 billed at list. Customer requesting retro credit of $27,300 and change to future invoices.

Ivy: I pulled the CRM entry  AE noted 'intro 35% M1-M6, approved verbally by AM' but no Deal Desk record. Invoice total = $78,000; 35% = $27,300. Support ticket SR-8043 has customer docs.

Carlos: Per policy: any pricing exception > $10k requires Deal Desk + Finance lead + Sales Ops. Also need to decide revenue treatment: is this a true pricing amendment (affects recognized revenue) or a one-off commercial concession?

Sam: Legal says LOI isn't a contract amendment; it's conditional on signature of master agreement. Sales requests honoring the LOI as commercial concession to keep deal moving. Sales Ops (Nina) advise classify as contra-revenue (GL 6520) and record in Deal Desk.

Nina: Opening Deal Desk DD-2026-552 with attachments and proposed credit memo CM-2026-08-21. Tagging @Carlos for finance sign-off and @Ivy for Sales Ops verification.

Ivy: SQL used for audit:
```
SELECT invoice_id, total_amount, discount_pct, total_amount * discount_pct AS credit
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'VEL-2026-07-01';
```
Result: VEL-2026-07-01, 78000, 0.35, 27300

Carlos: I'll provisionally approve the dollar amount but need a short approval note for accounting: 'one-time introductory concession per AE LOI; classify as contra-revenue GL 6520; no contract amendment until MA signed.' Finance lead approval logged in DD-2026-552.

Sam: Draft customer note: "We will issue a one-time retroactive credit of $27,300 to reflect the agreed introductory pricing for months 1-6. This is a one-time commercial concession and does not modify the master agreement. Future billing will follow the signed contract once executed." Send after credit posts? :email:

Nina: Send after posting. BillingBot, please queue CM-2026-08-21 for invoice VEL-2026-07-01 amount=27300 reason='introductory concession (AE LOI)'. Tag: special_pricing.

RevenueBot: queued credit memo CM-2026-08-21 (amount: $27,300) for invoice VEL-2026-07-01. ETA: 36h to post. Reference: #CM-2026-08-21.

Carlos: Also note for month-end close: impact on recognized revenue and deferred revenue schedule; record contra-rev under 6520 and attach DD-2026-552 for audit.

Ivy: Legal: confirm no upstream approvals required? Legal replied: LOI is non-binding on price; ok to honor as commercial concession.

RevenueBot: CM-2026-08-21 posted to customer account at 2026-08-25T15:07:12Z.

Sam: Confirmed posting. Sent customer message; CS reports customer pleased and moving to contract signature. Closing ticket SR-8043.

Carlos: Closing DD-2026-552 with GL=6520 and memo 'one-time intro concession honored; no contract amendment'. Finance closed. :white_check_mark:
